lead.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin sit down together for the first time
lead.standfirst: The three leaders met on Thursday at the APEC summit in Shenzhen, with Ukraine, Iran, trade, AI and nuclear arms on the agenda. Xi Jinping opened the day by pledging $20m to the forum and a research centre in the city, telling members they were “passengers riding the same ship”.

second.headline: Iran hits US sites in Kuwait as the Gulf war widens
second.dek: Tehran called its strikes on drone and missile sites self-defence, after a US attack on Qeshm Island. Bahrain activated air defences and Kuwait reported intercepting drones.

second.headline: EU proposes a €45bn loan Kyiv repays after reparations
second.dek: Von der Leyen's plan borrows on the markets: €25bn for arms, €20bn for the budget, serviced from profits on frozen Russian assets.

briefs.headline: Israeli tanks cross the Yellow Line into central Gaza
briefs.dek: The army said it struck a tunnel near Nuseirat. Hamas called the move a breach of the October 2025 truce.

briefs.headline: Amnesty seeks a war-crimes inquiry into RSF drone strikes
briefs.dek: Nine strikes on El Obeid between June and August killed 37 civilians, the rights group said.

briefs.headline: Egypt and Syria move to restore direct flights
briefs.dek: The two sides signed an operations protocol at ICAO in Montreal, 14 years after the air link was cut.

briefs.headline: Ukrainian drones cut more than half of Russia's refining
briefs.dek: Output has fallen below July's crisis levels, an analyst said, as Putin told APEC that sanctions had been beaten.

briefs.headline: Berlin presses to make Ukraine aid ‘Le Pen-proof’
briefs.dek: Germany wants future increases locked into the EU budget so that no single capital can veto them.

briefs.headline: ‘Feudal’ leasehold to be scrapped in England and Wales
briefs.dek: Ministers set out plans to end the system for millions of flat and house owners.

briefs.headline: China and South Korea close services and investment talks
briefs.dek: Seoul's media, gaming and travel stocks jumped as much as 30% on a deal nine years in the making.

briefs.headline: Magnitude 5.7 quake shakes Kumamoto and injures two
briefs.dek: The shock came at 2.22am local time at a lower-5 intensity. No tsunami warning was issued.

briefs.headline: Ethiopia and Eritrea mass troops along their border
briefs.dek: Monitors reported artillery near Badme. Eritrea denies intervening in Tigray and accuses Addis Ababa of seeking a pretext.

briefs.headline: Ghana's central bank cuts its rate 300bp to 11%
briefs.dek: The Bank of Ghana called the move a realignment. It is the lowest policy rate in 15 years.

briefs.headline: Senegal's ruling party expels President Faye
briefs.dek: Pastef moved against Bassirou Diomaye Faye, months after he dissolved the national assembly.

briefs.headline: Nigeria ties oil exports to its currency inflows
briefs.dek: The central bank and the state oil company will coordinate on export proceeds and lift crude output toward 3m barrels a day.

briefs.headline: JSE slumps 3.66% as gold and the rand slide
briefs.dek: Johannesburg's All Share closed at 106,572. October inflation rose to 5.2% before the Reserve Bank's decision.

briefs.headline: Brazil summons Argentina's envoy over Bolsonaro's flight
briefs.dek: Flavio Bolsonaro travelled through Argentina before reaching the United States, and Brasilia demanded an explanation.

briefs.headline: Musk says he regrets $445m of midterm spending
briefs.dek: At DealBook he said he felt “pretty foolish” and that he was not MAGA, after Democrats swept both chambers.

briefs.headline: Trump said to be frustrated with Vance over Iran blame
briefs.dek: The president has privately praised Marco Rubio, who defended the war, as Vance weighs a 2028 campaign.

briefs.headline: Colombia braces for a one-day national strike
briefs.dek: Unions and opposition groups called stoppages in five cities, and the US embassy warned of travel disruption.

briefs.headline: Pew projects Muslims will outnumber Christians by 2035
briefs.dek: Birth rates, not conversion, drive the shift to 2.57bn Muslims against 2.52bn Christians.

briefs.headline: Van Gogh evening scene sells for a record $190.4m
briefs.dek: Sotheby's said the sale followed an eleventh-hour settlement with the heirs of a previous Jewish owner.
